### The God Who Encourages Us
Author: Michael A. Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-september-10-2026.html
Passage: Haggai 2:4
Points:
- When facing external opposition and discouragement, God calls His people to remain strong and keep working.
- God does not ignore hardship, but offers comfort through the assurance of His enduring presence.
- The remedy for doubt and fear is resting in the Lord's pledge to never forsake His people.
- Through Christ, believers are God's dwelling place, filled with His glory and sustaining peace.

### The Latter Glory of the Lord's House
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/latter-glory-lords-house
Passage: Haggai 2:9
Points:
- The rebuilt temple seemed insignificant to those who remembered the former majesty of Solomon's temple.
- God urged the remnant to walk by persevering faith rather than evaluating success by immediate outward appearances.
- The Lord assured them that His presence was with them and that a greater glory was yet to come.
- This promised glory and peace point forward to the ultimate restoration fulfilled through the gospel of Christ.
